top_signals.title: Gold Advances to Near $4,700 as Debasement Trade Powers Rally
top_signals.summary: Gold climbed to the highest in more than three months, extending a rally sparked by the surprise bond-market intervention that’s revived concerns around US fiscal policy and dollar weakness.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Londoners find ‘horrendous’ cracks in their homes after successive heat waves
top_signals.summary: Hot, dry weather shrinking soil and destabilizing building foundations is now part of a long list of heat-related challenges to which the U.K. is now struggling to adapt.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
